get.description: Returns the direct children of `parent_uuid` in the company portfolio-program hierarchy, each with Capital Planning rollups over its full visible subtree. `parent_uuid=root` returns the top tier plus metadata and the grand total; a node uuid returns that node’s children. Read-only.

parameters.name: snapshot_id
parameters.description: When set, serves the tier from the hierarchy frozen in the given completed snapshot instead of the live tree. Same params and response shape; `parent_uuid` resolves against the snapshot’s nodes. 404 for a missing or foreign snapshot, 409 while it is still building.

parameters.name: filters[in_plan][]
parameters.description: Filter by in-plan state. Accepts `true` or `false`; sending both, or omitting it, returns projects in either state.

parameters.name: filters[portfolio_program][]
parameters.description: Portfolio-hierarchy node filter. Send node uuids, or the sentinel `none` to include projects with no node (or a node not yet synced). Matches the project’s own node only (no descendants).

parameters.name: filters[program][]
parameters.description: Legacy program filter. Send the program's procore_program_id, or the sentinel `none` to include projects with no program.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match on project name or number

parameters.name: include_rows
parameters.description: Default true. With `parent_uuid=root&include_rows=false` the response carries `metadata` and `grand_total` only, with `data: []`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sibling order as `field:asc|desc`. Fields: name, planned_amount, original_budget, revised_budget, job_to_date_costs, forecast_to_complete, estimated_cost_at_completion, remaining, descendant_project_count. Default `name:asc`. The Unassigned row stays last regardless of sort.

parameters.name: parent_uuid
parameters.description: `root` for the top-level tier (Unassigned row included, last), or a node uuid for its direct children. `none` is invalid — the Unassigned row has no child programs.

200.description: One hierarchy tier; metadata and grand total on the root tier

data.description: One sibling tier, ordered per `sort` and paged. The Unassigned row is last on the root tier regardless of sort.

uuid.description: Node uuid. `null` only on a synthetic Unassigned row: the root one (`parent_uuid` `null`) or the one listed last in a program's child tier (`parent_uuid` = that program).

procore_id.description: Upstream Procore program id. Reference only, never a lookup key.

parent_uuid.description: Parent node uuid; `null` at the root tier.

procore_level_id.description: Hierarchy level id; `null` on the Unassigned row.

level_label.description: Level label resolved from `metadata.hierarchy.levels`; `null` on the Unassigned row.

has_children.description: True when at least one visible child program exists. Expand fetches `/portfolio_programs?parent_uuid=<uuid>`.

project_count.description: Visible projects assigned directly to this node. When `has_children` is true, they are listed under a synthetic Unassigned row last in the node's child tier; otherwise expand fetches `/projects?portfolio_program_uuid=<uuid>`.

descendant_project_count.description: Visible projects across the full subtree (equals `project_count` on leaves).

monthly_forecasts.description: Summed monthly forecasts across the subtree, keyed `YYYY-MM`.

currency_display.description: Preferred currency display/symbol from company Currency Settings.

permission_level.description: The requesting user's Capital Planning permission level, used by the UI to gate admin-only affordances (e.g. the settings entry point).

enabled.description: True when at least one hierarchy level is ingested for the company. When false the UI renders the legacy program view.

levels.description: Hierarchy levels ordered by position ascending.

programs.description: Legacy programs with at least one visible project, for the `filters[program][]` picker. The client appends the `none` option.

grand_total.description: Company-wide totals over the filtered project set. Present on `parent_uuid=root` requests only.

409.description: SNAPSHOT_NOT_READY — the snapshot has not finished building

503.description: The permission check could not be completed (`AUTHORIZATION_UNAVAILABLE`) — safe to retry
